name: Pumpkin
author: lilalexmed@proton.me
description: Pumpkin is a Minecraft server built entirely in Rust, offering a fast, efficient, and customizable experience. It prioritizes performance and player enjoyment while adhering to the core mechanics of the game.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eux

apk add --no-cache curl
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "$ARCH" in
    x86_64|amd64)
        PUMPKIN_ARCH="X64"
        ;;
    aarch64|arm64)
        PUMPKIN_ARCH="ARM64"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

BINARY_NAME="pumpkin-${PUMPKIN_ARCH}-Linux-musl"
REPO="${GITHUB_PACKAGE:-Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin}"

if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    URL="$DOWNLOAD_URL"
elif [ "${VERSION:-nightly}" = "nightly" ]; then
    URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/nightly/${BINARY_NAME}"
elif [ "$VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
    URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest/download/${BINARY_NAME}"
else
    URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${VERSION}/${BINARY_NAME}"
fi

echo "Downloading Pumpkin from: $URL"
# Download to a temporary file so a failed download never replaces a working binary.
curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$URL" -o pumpkin.download
mv -f pumpkin.download pumpkin
chmod +x pumpkin

# Seed a minimal config so the panel can write the allocated port on the first start.
# Pumpkin fills in every other setting with its defaults when it starts.
if [ ! -f pumpkin.toml ]; then
    printf '[networking.java]\naddress = "0.0.0.0:25565"\n' > pumpkin.toml
fi

variables.name: Rust backtrace
variables.description:
"0" -> No backtrace is generated. This is the default behavior.
"1" -> Generates a minimal backtrace showing only relevant information about where the panic occurred.
"full" -> Generates a detailed backtrace, showing all frames leading to the panic, including functions in the Rust standard library and dependencies.
